prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic fine-art portrait of an adult woman with soft natural features, minimal skin-focused makeup, and a calm introspective expression. Use a muted pastel sage-green seamless background. A delicate ivory flower drifts across the foreground on a long stem, partially obscuring one eye and creating intentional horizontal slow-shutter motion blur and soft streaks of light. Add only subtle poetic double exposure across the face. Keep facial focus sharp, natural skin texture visible, shallow depth of field, cinematic softness, painterly realism, gentle diffused lighting, and a serene emotional tone.
